title: Google cloud outage takes down banks
summary: Google Cloud experienced a significant outage that disrupted services at multiple major financial institutions including HSBC, Revolut, Bank of Scotland, Lloyds, and Equifax, highlighting the critical dependency of banking services on cloud infrastructure.
problem_solved: This article documents rather than solves a problem, but it raises awareness about the vulnerability of critical financial services to cloud provider failures.
why_valuable: It demonstrates the cascading impact of cloud infrastructure failures on essential services and underscores the importance of redundancy planning in modern financial systems.
